data.name: FloraFarm
data.detailed_description:
The Isometric Farm is a cozy, hand-crafted farming simulator where you turn a small patch of grass into a thriving, beautiful farm. Till the soil, plant your seeds, water your crops, and harvest them for profit — then reinvest everything to grow bigger, unlock rare plants, and meet a colorful cast of vendors.

Plant, Grow & Harvest

Work your land tile by tile with a simple, satisfying toolset — **Hoe, Plant, Water, and Harvest**. Watch every crop grow through multiple stages, and keep them watered to speed up their growth. From humble violet flowers to exotic blooms, every harvest brings you closer to your dream farm.

Expand Your Farm

Start small and grow big. Spend your hard-earned coins to **expand your land across multiple levels** — each expansion opens up more space to cultivate and unlocks brand-new vendors to trade with.

Meet the Vendors

A cast of characters lives on your farm, each with something to offer:

- The Seed Seller — your go-to for everyday seeds.

- The Farmer — helps you expand your land.

- The Herbalist — sells powerful tools like the Harvesting Pliers and the Auto-Waterer.

- The Nursery — unlocks rare plants: Red Valerian, Blue Agapanthus, Lavender, and Flowering Cactus.

- The Botanist — offers truly special species, including the Venus Flytrap and the Magic Mushroom.

Hidden Riches

Your land hides more than dirt. Clear rocks and dig up rare diamonds scattered across the ground — a lucky find that can pay off big.

Tools & Upgrades

Make farming faster and easier with smart upgrades. Level up your Harvesting Pliers for more efficient harvests, and let the Auto-Waterer keep your crops hydrated while you focus on growing your empire.

Play Your Way

- Multiple save slots so you can manage several farms.

- Full settings menu — audio, controls, gameplay, and accessibility options.

- A relaxing pace with no pressure — just you, your land, and time to grow.

Grab your hoe. Your farm is waiting. A game by Fanteh Studios.
